title: stackscan report
description: Inventory sent by `stackscan push`, schema version 1. Only these fields are ever sent.

stackscan_version.description: Version of the CLI that produced the report.

git.description: Present when the scanned folder is a git repository.

eco.description: runtime: a product tracked on endoflife.date (php, nodejs, postgresql...); image: a Docker image; otherwise a package ecosystem.

name.description: Product, image repository or package name.

version.description: Installed version, image tag, or version constraint when `declared` is true.

source.description: Manifest path relative to the scanned folder (e.g. app/composer.lock). Replaced by a hash with `push --redact-paths`.

image.description: For a runtime deduced from a Docker image: the image repository it comes from.

direct.description: Declared directly by the project, not a transitive dependency.

declared.description: Version comes from a constraint (composer.json, package.json engines), not from a lock file.

floating.description: The reference can change without a commit (image tag `latest`, `redis:7`...).
